newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Spartanburg Sanitary, S.C..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Spartanburg Sanitary, S.C..

text.p: SPARTANBURG SANITARY SEWER DISTRICT, SOUTH CAROLINA
SEALED PROPOSALS, addressed to the undersigned, will be received by the Spartanburg Sanitary Sewer District (the "District"), until Noon (local time) on

for the purchase of $7,190,000 of GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS, SERIES 1997, OF SPARTANBURG SANITARY SEWER DISTRICT, SOUTH CAROLINA. The Bond will be issued as a single, fully-registe bond, in the principal amount of $7,190,000.

The Bond will be a general obligation bond of the District, payable both as to principal and interest from ad valorem ta imposed upon all taxable property within the District withou limit as to rate or amount.

The Bond will be dated, and will bear interest from, Februa 1997. The Bond will be payable by equal quarterly payments principal and interest, on each February 1, May 1, August 1, November 1, beginning on May 1, 1997 and ending on February 2011.

The Bond is prepayable in whole or in part at any time with penalty. Any prepayment shall, after payment of interest, b applied to the installments last to become due under the Bon shall not affect the obligation of the District to pay the remaining scheduled installments until the principal balance fully paid.

Bids should be stated as to the amount of the quarterly pay on the schedule described above, that the bidder requires to fully amortize the Bond on February 1, 2011. Subject to the paragraph, the bid requiring the lowest quarterly payment wi awarded the Bond. Each bid must also state the interest rat used to calculate its bid, based on a 360-day year of 12 thi day months. The purchase price of the Bond will be the prin amount of $7,190,000 plus accrued interest thereon from Febr 1, 1997.

The Bond is being offered to replace a loan that the Distri currently has from a State agency. The State agency loan ha above-stated maturity schedule, with quarterly payments $176,398.92. For purposes of comparing bids, the State agen loan is deemed to be a qualifying bid. Consequently, no oth bid should be submitted with a quarterly payment requirement excess of $176,398.92.

The Bond will be accompanied by an approving opinion as to validity and as to the exemption of interest thereon from So Carolina and federal income taxation from Sinkler & Boyd, P. The Bond WILL NOT be bank-qualified pursuant to Section 265( the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 as amended.
If the Bond is awarded to a bidder other than the State age it will be delivered on or about February 28, 1997, against payment of the purchase price in immediately available feder funds.
No disclosure document is being prepared in connection with Bond. The successful bidder will be required to deliver pri closing a certificate that it has such knowledge and experie

in financial and business matters that it is capa evaluating the merits and risks of its investment in the Bon and is financially able to bear the economic risk of its investment in the Bond; that it has had the opportunity to a questions of, and receive answers from, the District concern the terms and conditions of the offering and any ot information which it has deemed relevant to the Bond and its investment in the Bond; that the Bond is being purchased for own account and for the purpose of investment and not presen for resale; and that it has no present intention of offering Bond or any portion thereof for resale either currently or a the passage of a fixed period of time, or upon the occurrenc nonoccurrence of any predetermined event or circumstances. Bids, and any question prior to bid, should be submitted to District, attention of G. Newton Pressley, Treasurer, at 200 Commerce Street, Spartanburg, South Carolina 29304-02
